Vendor Onboarding Guide

This guide explains how a new supplier is registered with Kaveri Textiles procurement.

Documents Required

  • GST registration certificate (GSTIN)
  • PAN card of the business
  • Cancelled cheque or bank letter for the payment account
  • MSME Udyam certificate, if the vendor is a registered micro, small or medium enterprise

Approval Process

The requesting department raises a vendor request in the ERP. Procurement verifies the GSTIN on the GST portal and the bank account through a penny-drop test. Finance approves the vendor within 5 working days of receiving complete documents.

Payment Terms

Standard payment terms are 45 days from the invoice date. Registered MSME vendors are paid within 45 days as required by the MSMED Act, and never later. Advance payments above INR 2 lakh need CFO approval.
